name: Inspur Electronic Information Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Inspur Electronic Information Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides cloud computing and big data services in China and internationally. The company offers computing equipment, including storage, intelligent network, and cloud operating systems; software products, such as intelligent ERPs, enterprise and industry PaaS platforms, and databases; government and enterprise cloud services; and industrial internet products comprising industrial internet platform, safety, communication, equipment, application, supply chain, and equipment health management.
